# kion_webhook (Resource)

Manages a Kion Webhook.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_webhook" "example" {
  # Required
  callout_url        = "example"
  name               = "example"
  timeout_in_seconds = 1

  # Optional
  # description             = "example"
  # owner_user_group_ids    = []
  # owner_user_ids          = []
  # request_body            = "example"
  # request_headers         = "example"
  # request_method          = "example"
  # should_send_secure_info = false
  # skip_ssl                = false
  # use_request_headers     = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `callout_url` (String) URL the application will call when the webhook is triggered.
- `name` (String) Name of the webhook in the application.
- `timeout_in_seconds` (Number) The number of seconds the application will wait before considering the webhook "timed out".

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description for the webhook in the application.
- `owner_user_group_ids` (Set of Number) List of groups IDs who will own the webhook. Is required if no owner user IDs are listed.
- `owner_user_ids` (Set of Number) List of user IDs who will own the webhook. Is required if no owner group IDs are listed.
- `request_body` (String) HTTP request payload body to use when the webhook is triggered.
- `request_headers` (String) HTTP headers to use when the webhook is triggered.
- `request_method` (String) HTTP request method to use when the webhook is triggered.
- `should_send_secure_info` (Boolean) Will be true when the request to the webhook will include temporary AWS access keys.
- `skip_ssl` (Boolean) Will be true when the request to the webhook will skip certificate verification.
- `use_request_headers` (Boolean) Will be true when intending to send the request headers specified above.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Webhook ID.
